fertiliser.state: Hormuz carries about a third of world urea exports, and tankers were attacked in and near the strait again on 5–6 Nov (CBS News). CBS also reported that US escorts have brought Gulf shipments back near pre-war levels, and this run found no current report that the export route is closed or of urea prices up 60% in three months (farmdoc daily). The status moves to Watch; the Alert is unconfirmed.
fertiliser.for_you: Farmers face higher fertiliser costs and supply uncertainty, which can feed into food prices next season. Import-dependent countries in South Asia and Africa are most exposed.
fertiliser.rubric_hit: Watch: key export route disrupted; closure and >60% urea rise not confirmed this run

nuclear-plants.summary: Zaporizhzhia's off-site power remains fragile as Russian strikes hit Ukraine's grid
nuclear-plants.state: Substation damage has delayed the use of a repaired Zaporizhzhia power line, leaving the plant on fragile off-site power, according to IAEA updates (World Nuclear News; IAEA). Russia said it struck a 330kV substation in Dnipropetrovsk region on 5 Nov as attacks on Ukraine's energy system continue (Al Jazeera). No damage to safety systems or radiological release had been reported as of 6 Nov.
nuclear-plants.for_you: There is no radiation risk outside the area. Follow IAEA and national regulator updates; the UK government advises against all travel to Ukraine's occupied areas.
nuclear-plants.rubric_hit: Watch: off-site power fragile amid strikes on the grid; no safety-system damage

hybrid-threats.summary: Hoax bomb threats disrupt at least 27 European flights on 5 Nov; no state blamed
hybrid-threats.state: Emailed bomb threats disrupted at least 27 passenger flights across ten European countries on 5 Nov, the second wave that week; French jets escorted an Aer Lingus Dublin–Rome flight to Évreux and Bulgaria escorted three airliners (Al Jazeera). No explosives were found and no government has named a culprit; the EU said it was too early to say whether the alerts were linked (Skift).
hybrid-threats.for_you: Expect occasional diversions and security checks on European flights; follow airline and airport instructions.
hybrid-threats.rubric_hit: Wave of disruptive incidents in Europe, not yet attributed to a state = Watch (kept)

gulf-iran.value: US strike on Qeshm 7 Nov; talks via Qatar
gulf-iran.summary: US strikes Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island on 7 Nov as Iran weighs Qatari proposals for a bridge deal
gulf-iran.state: The US carried out limited strikes on Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz overnight into 7 Nov, which President Trump called minor; the Revolutionary Guards said they downed a US drone over Qeshm on 6 Nov (Euronews). Regional officials said Iran is reviewing a Qatari proposal that would lift the US port blockade and reopen Hormuz, and Qatar denied that talks had collapsed (Arab News, citing Reuters). Active strikes between states continue.
gulf-iran.for_you: Travellers to the Gulf should follow FCDO travel advice, which is being updated as the conflict develops.
gulf-iran.rubric_hit: Active US strikes on Iran (7 Nov) = Alert

other-conflicts.summary: Afghan–Pakistan border clashes continue after Moscow talks ended without agreement
other-conflicts.state: Clashes between Pakistani forces and the Afghan Taliban continued along the border through late October after talks in Moscow ended without agreement, amid reports of Pakistani outreach to anti-Taliban groups (Long War Journal, 29 Oct). Searches on 6 Nov found no new interstate war, attack on a capital or mass-atrocity warning in a conflict not tracked elsewhere.
other-conflicts.for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Afghanistan, Pakistan's border areas and southern Ethiopia.
other-conflicts.rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration in conflicts not tracked elsewhere; no new interstate war

cold-storms.summary: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations
cold-storms.state: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings covering a major region were found as of 6 Nov. NOAA's hazards outlook shows no major cold outbreak for the US. Earlier mountain snow advisories in the US Rockies on 4–5 Nov caused no widespread outages.
cold-storms.for_you: Nothing unusual for early November. For forecasts and warnings, check the Met Office in the UK or your national weather service.
cold-storms.rubric_hit: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations (Normal)

respiratory.summary: Early H1N1 flu season: US flu admissions up 27% in a week; no WHO variant of concern
respiratory.state: US flu hospital admissions rose 27% in a week and the CDC reported the season's first child death, in an early season driven by a drifted H1N1 strain (Medical Daily; CDC FluView). In England, UKHSA's 29 Oct report showed flu GP swab positivity rising to 11.0%. Health systems are not reported as strained, and no WHO variant of concern had been designated as of 6 Nov.
respiratory.for_you: In the UK, the NHS offers free flu vaccination to eligible groups, including over-65s, young children and people with long-term conditions; check NHS guidance. Older adults and young children are most at risk of severe illness.
respiratory.rubric_hit: Northern Hemisphere flu season unusually early; no variant of concern or health-system strain (Watch)

medicine-shortages.value: US chemo shortages; SA clinic stockouts
medicine-shortages.summary: US sterile injectable shortages persist; South African public clinics short of psychiatric drugs
medicine-shortages.state: The FDA's shortage database still lists dozens of current shortages, mostly sterile injectables including cytarabine and irinotecan (FDA). In South Africa, public clinics are short of psychiatric and other medicines, and some patients are buying them privately, TimesLIVE reported on 6 Nov. No widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems, and no new UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine, was found as of 6 Nov.
medicine-shortages.for_you: If your medicine is out of stock, your pharmacist or prescriber can advise on alternatives; in the UK, NHS guidance covers what to do. Patients on sterile injectables and psychiatric drugs are most exposed.
medicine-shortages.rubric_hit: Shortages of essential medicines in several countries; no widespread rationing across major health systems (Watch)

exploited-vulns.summary: Three new CISA known-exploited vulnerabilities in a week, including SonicWall VPN
exploited-vulns.state: CISA added three vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue in the seven days to 6 Nov and 30 in 30 days, under the 11-a-week Watch line. The latest are a SonicWall SSL VPN flaw (6 Nov), an Apple flaw (4 Nov) and WordPress Core (3 Nov).
exploited-vulns.for_you: Organisations using SonicWall VPNs should apply vendor patches, following CISA and NCSC advice.

aid-funding.value: WFP Gaza cuts; Sudan stocks empty
aid-funding.summary: WFP cuts Gaza food aid for 500,000; IOM says its Sudan shelter warehouses are empty
aid-funding.state: WFP cut monthly food aid in Gaza by about 500,000 people from late October because of funding shortfalls (WFP). On 6 Nov UNHCR and IOM said funding lets them reach only about 10% of the 15.4 million people in Sudan who need shelter, and IOM's Sudan warehouses are empty (Reuters via TimesLIVE). No formal suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country had been announced as of 6 Nov.
aid-funding.for_you: Mainly affects aid recipients in Gaza and Sudan. Cuts tend to raise malnutrition and push more people to move in search of help.
aid-funding.rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts announced (WFP Gaza); no large-scale suspension in famine-risk countries

uk-supply-margins.summary: No NESO or National Gas margin notices in force; last electricity margin call on 6 Oct
uk-supply-margins.state: NESO issued an Electricity Margin Notice on 28 Sep, later cancelled, and called for extra generation on 6 Oct when the margin fell to 1.88 GW (New Civil Engineer; Energy Live News). Searches on 6 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice issued since.
uk-supply-margins.for_you: Margin notices are routine signals to generators and rarely affect households. Power cuts from supply shortfalls are very unlikely at this level.
uk-supply-margins.rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO or National Gas notices in force as of 6 Nov

uk-floods.state: The Environment Agency had no severe flood warnings, flood warnings or flood alerts in force in England at 05:40 UTC on 7 Nov.
uk-floods.for_you: No action needed; sign up for Environment Agency flood warnings if you live in a flood-risk area.
